title: 49GAION Standard - bot identity card
description: Every bot states its role, its own separate account, its allowed actions, and the actions that require a prior request to the accountable human.

aioc.description: Widened in v1.5.0 to accept brand prefixes such as TenAIOC-SL and [ORG]AIOC-SL (Naming Standard R13).

role.description: The role card the bot performs.

separate.description: The bot's own account; never a human's and never shared with another bot.

ask_first_actions.description: Actions that require a prior request to the accountable human.

accountable_human_position.description: The position (never a person's name) of the accountable human. For the AION Builder: the governing seat (GOV) of 49GAION.

status.description: DRAFT until the card's test has run once with recorded evidence; APPROVED only with that evidence.
